stem.text: Some gas in a cylinder is supplied with thermal energy $q$.
The gas does useful work in expanding at constant pressure $p$ from volume $V_0$ to volume $V_\text{F}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Cylinder containing gas, with a piston and an outlet rod on the right, a bracket above labelled volume V0, a bracket below labelled volume VF, and the label gas pressure p.

stem.text: Which expression gives the efficiency of this change?
